## ConnectionService.processInvitation() method

Process a received invitation message. This will not accept the invitation or send an invitation request message. It will only create a connection record with all the information about the invitation stored. Use [ConnectionService.createRequest()](./core.connectionservice.createrequest.md) after calling this function to create a connection request.

<b>Signature:</b>

```typescript
processInvitation(invitation: ConnectionInvitationMessage, config: {
        routing: Routing;
        autoAcceptConnection?: boolean;
        alias?: string;
    }): Promise<ConnectionRecord>;
```
